description: Minimum capability set for the main window. ADR 0001 requires capabilities to be granted to exact windows and exact commands, so this grants neither a plugin's default permission set nor access to any window other than `main`. Notification is granted as three exact commands rather than `notification:default`, which additionally carries permission-state and channel management the shell does not use. Shell and process access stay absent: ADR 0002 chose a remote-only desktop app, and ADR 0001 keeps process execution unavailable to frontend code regardless.
